correctness.rationale: Stationary two-state transition has nonconstant eigenvalue rho, hence P(all selected zero)=u product(u+p rho^gap). Enumerating all 15 labeled set partitions reduces to 4-pool, optimized 3+1, optimized 2+2 and singletons; 2+1+1 is dominated by 2+2 or all singletons according as u*A2 crosses 1/2. For rho<0, gap-two maximizes each factor and 2b-a-c=-p*rho*(1-rho)^2>0; positive-rho 2+2 is dominated by the 4-pool or singletons (including rho=0 boundary). Exact rational witnesses verify each negative-rho open phase; for a single h-pool n>=2h-1, the factor maximum is uniquely gap2 for negative rho and gap1 for positive rho. Independent script exhaustively enumerated 15 partitions at rational feasible points, which supplements but does not replace this continuous proof.
residual_risks: Assumes perfect testing, stationary Markov chain, strict feasible rho, arbitrary nonlocal pooling. No theorem that multi-pool optimum for n>4 has parity pools.

evidence: Lendle et al. derive hierarchical/matrix efficiency under exchangeable correlated binary responses; Landolfi–Lall optimize Dorfman partitions under symmetric/exchangeable laws.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Exchangeability erases index gaps, so neither stated model can imply a negative nearest-neighbor alternating-pair phase; broader in pool size is not broader in dependence class.

evidence: General expected tests 1+m(1-q) is prior art; the chain-specific q(H)=u∏(u+p rho^gap) and global parity competition are additional.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Correlated-pool formula alone only sets up the optimization, does not decide all 15 partitions under stationary nonexchangeable negative rho.

value.rationale: A motivated exact combinatorial screening optimization: negative serial correlation can make noncontiguous parity pools optimal even when adjacent pools seem natural, and the four qualitative regimes have sharp parameter boundaries and attainable open phases. This is stronger and scientifically different from merely reporting a finite candidate minimum.
residual_risks: Transfer to epidemiological practice requires validating negative correlation and costs.
